cards.title: agentctl

cards.evidence: 71 tests · 22 live acceptance checks · 4 review rounds

cards.title: parity
cards.thesis: Checks that the same computation gives the same answer on different hardware. Harder than it sounds.
cards.evidence: 2 fixtures · equivalence criteria locked in before any backend evidence

cards.title: trace-npm
cards.thesis: Shows what npm install scripts actually touch, spawn, and call. Good to know before you run one.
cards.evidence: Published on npm · strace-based runtime trace

cards.title: Computational studies

cards.evidence: 7 public Sekiya studies · live neural-field study
